tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Lists available thumbnail image models with the price per image in USD.

tools.name: generate_thumbnails
tools.description: Generates thumbnail images from a prompt with one or more models (up to 8 images per call). Waits for results and returns image URLs valid for one hour. Billed per image to the API key's account.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Returns the status and fresh image URLs for a generation id.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Shows free allowance left, this month's spend and billing status for the API key's account.
